result.summary: DeepSeek-V3 是一个总参数 671B、每 token 激活 37B 的 MoE 语言模型，沿用 MLA 与 DeepSeekMoE 架构，并引入无辅助损失的负载均衡策略和多 token 预测训练目标 [abstract][S1.p2]。模型在 14.8T token 上预训练，随后经过 SFT 与 RL 后训练，并采用 FP8 混合精度训练与 DualPipe 等工程优化 [S1.p3][S1.p4]。综合评测显示其性能超过其他开源模型，并可与领先闭源模型相比，而完整训练仅需 2.788M H800 GPU 小时 [abstract][S1.p6]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在进一步推动开源模型能力边界，通过扩大模型规模并引入 DeepSeek-V3 来缩小与闭源模型的差距 [S1.p1]。作者同时追求强模型性能与经济成本，因此在架构上继续采用 MLA 以实现高效推理、采用 DeepSeekMoE 以实现低成本训练 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: To further push the boundaries of open-source model capabilities, we scale up our models and introduce DeepSeek-V3
we consistently strive for strong model performance and economical costs

method.text: DeepSeek-V3 采用 MLA 进行高效推理、采用 DeepSeekMoE 进行经济训练，并额外引入无辅助损失的负载均衡策略以减轻负载均衡带来的性能损失 [S2.SS1.p1]。模型还设置多 token 预测训练目标，在每个位置扩展预测范围到多个未来 token [S2.SS2.p1]。训练方面支持 FP8 混合精度训练，并设计 DualPipe 算法实现高效流水线并行和计算-通信重叠 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: DeepSeek-V3 also adopts MLA and DeepSeekMoE, which have been thoroughly validated by DeepSeek-V2
we additionally introduce an auxiliary-loss-free load balancing strategy for DeepSeekMoE
we investigate and set a Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) objective for DeepSeek-V3
we introduce an FP8 mixed precision training framework
we design the DualPipe algorithm for efficient pipeline parallelism

experiments.text: 预训练使用 14.8T 高质量且多样化的 token，最大序列长度设为 4K [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。长上下文扩展采用 YaRN，分两阶段将上下文窗口从 4K 扩展到 32K 再到 128K [S4.SS3.p1]。评测覆盖多学科选择题、语言理解与推理、闭卷问答、阅读理解、数学、代码等基准，并采用困惑度、生成式或语言建模等不同评估方式 [S4.SS4.SSS1.p2][S4.SS4.SSS1.p12]。后训练阶段构建了 1.5M 条指令微调数据，并使用 GRPO 进行强化学习 [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: We set the maximum sequence length to 4K during pre-training, and pre-train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8T tokens
we apply YaRN for context extension and perform two additional training phases
to progressively expand the context window from 4K to 32K and then to 128K
Multi-subject multiple-choice datasets include MMLU, MMLU-Redux, MMLU-Pro, MMMLU, C-Eval, and CMMLU
we adopt perplexity-based evaluation for datasets including HellaSwag, PIQA, WinoGrande
We curate our instruction-tuning datasets to include 1.5M instances spanning multiple domains
we adopt Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)

findings.text: 综合评测显示 DeepSeek-V3 超过其他开源模型，并达到与领先闭源模型相当的性能 [abstract]。DeepSeek-V3-Base 在多数基准上取得最佳表现，尤其在数学和代码任务上 [S4.T3]。聊天版本在标准与开放式基准上超过其他开源模型，并与 GPT-4o 和 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 等领先闭源模型性能相当 [S1.p5]。训练过程非常稳定，整个训练过程中未出现不可恢复的损失尖峰，也未执行回滚 [abstract]。完整训练仅需 2.788M H800 GPU 小时 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: Comprehensive evaluations reveal that DeepSeek-V3 outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models
DeepSeek-V3-Base achieves the best performance on most benchmarks, especially on math and code tasks
Its chat version also outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models
we did not experience any irrecoverable loss spikes or perform any rollbacks
DeepSeek-V3 requires only 2.788M H800 GPU hours for its full training

limitations.text: 作者承认 DeepSeek-V3 在部署方面存在局限：为保证高效推理，推荐部署单元相对较大，可能给小型团队带来负担 [S6.p2]。此外，尽管部署策略已实现超过 DeepSeek-V2 两倍的端到端生成速度，仍有进一步提升的空间 [S6.p2]。作者认为这些局限有望随着更先进硬件的发展自然得到解决 [S6.p2]。

evidence.quote: the recommended deployment unit for DeepSeek-V3 is relatively large, which might pose a burden for small-sized teams
there still remains potential for further enhancement
these limitations are expected to be naturally addressed with the development of more advanced hardware
